$comment: Hand-kept part of the accessibility matrix (scripts/build-a11y.mjs merges it with what it reads from the code). screenReader: one entry per real assistive-technology pass, e.g. { "Button": [{ "at": "VoiceOver", "browser": "Safari 19", "date": "2026-10-05", "result": "pass", "notes": "" }] }. deviations: accepted deviations specific to one component. focusRingOnly: components where the soft focus ring is the only visible focus change (WCAG 1.4.11 accepted deviation, see the WCAG audit, 2026-09-27). traits: per-component corrections to the traits build-a11y.mjs reads from the code ({ add, remove, note }). reviews: one recorded manual review per criterion (result: pass | fail | n/a — n/a confirms the code trait was a false positive for that criterion), e.g. { "Button": { "2.5.3": { "result": "pass", "date": "2026-10-08", "by": "Maria", "note": "" } } }.
